$description: Retro Box design tokens. The source of truth for colour is retrobox/config.py — ui.color and ui.dim_color. Everything else is derived from those two and from the CRT the product is imitating.

$surfaces.osd: The on-screen display drawn over video. retrobox/overlay.py, retrobox/crt.py
$surfaces.dashboard: The browser dashboard on the box. retrobox/webui.py
$surfaces.brand: Logo, share cards, anything printed. brand/

phosphor.$description: Lit text. Idents, channel numbers, controls, links, the wordmark. Comes from ui.color.

unlit.$description: An unlit segment. Volume dots that are off, hairline rules, inactive borders. NEVER text — it is 1.59:1 on tube and fails every contrast threshold. Comes from ui.dim_color.

tube.$description: The screen with nothing on it. Near-black, very slightly blue, because a real CRT is never truly black.

paper.$description: Body copy on the site. A page of glowing green paragraphs is unreadable; the box only ever prints short strings, so long-form text steps out of the phosphor.

lede.$description: Opening paragraphs. One step brighter than paper.

sub.$description: The JV PROJECTS line under the wordmark. Phosphor stepped back so it never competes with the name above it.

ember.$description: The only colour that is not green. Reserved for destructive controls on the dashboard and, on the site, for the two places the product tells you something you might not want to hear. Spend it rarely.

ink.$description: The logo on light backgrounds and in print. Same value as tube, inverted in role.

rule.$description: A hairline you are meant to see. Phosphor at low alpha reads on a dark ground where unlit does not.

wash.$description: Panel fill. The faintest suggestion that a region is a region.

hover.$description: Hover and focus fill on controls.

selected.$description: The highlighted row in the guide and the menu.

display.$description: VT323. Headings, idents, numbers, controls, the guide, the wordmark. Never body copy — it is a pixel terminal face and it is painful in paragraphs.

body.$value: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
body.$description: Whatever the reader's system already has. Nothing to download, nothing to wait for, nothing to track.

glow.$description: Phosphor bloom. Goes on green only. Putting it on body copy is the single fastest way to make this look amateur.

scanlines.$description: Used sparingly: the hero screen and the section dividers on the site, the whole viewport on the dashboard. A page that is entirely distressed is unreadable.

cornerRadius.$description: Rounded corner as a fraction of screen width.

channelBug.$description: How long the channel banner lingers. config: channel_bug_seconds. The site's scroll banner uses the same number.

guide.$description: How long the guide stays up. config: guide_seconds.

bridge.$description: Keep the current show playing while the next loads. config: bridge_seconds.

transition.$description: Hover and focus on controls. Short enough to feel like a hardware button.

screen.$description: Anything standing in for a television.

tapTarget.$description: Minimum height for anything you can press.
